conviction_note: Production, sales and cash for Q3 are already public, and revenue lands on the bar. So the print turns on whether the 70-75koz FY guide survives: it needs a Q4 32-61% above Q3 while recovery fell to 52.5%. That is a modest negative lean (p_up 45) on a ~5.5% abs move. The findings sum to -1.1 and the scaled number is -0.55. They agree in sign, and the gap is only the difference between per-finding sizing and a probability tier.

findings.finding: Guide-survival risk. YTD production is 46,666 oz, so the reaffirmed FY2026 guide of 70,000-75,000 oz needs 23,334-28,334 oz in Q4, which is +32% to +61% over Q3's 17,652 oz. Q3 blended recovery fell to 52.5% (from 57.8% in Q2 and 58.5% in H1) as more run-of-mine ore went to the pads. A trim to the guide, or a 'low end' comment, at the Nov 11 release or Nov 12 call would land on the line this producer trades on. On the other side: management reaffirmed on 2026-10-22, three weeks into Q4, and ore placed rose 25% q/q (5.2Mt), with heap-leach lag pushing recovered ounces into Q4.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q3 production release with guidance reaffirmed (2026-10-22 amc) moved -2.21% (baseline). The Q2 results with guidance maintained (2026-08-11 amc) moved +3.85%. No guidance cut is on record to measure; per Earnings Whispers the stock has fallen ~21% since the July mine-plan update.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the stock is -7% over 20 days, near its post-earnings low and 54% off its high, and Panabee/Crux have published the Q4-ramp arithmetic. What is not in the price is the answer. If the market expected a cut, the reaffirmation on Oct 22 would have been met with relief rather than -2.2%. If it fully expected the guide to hold, the stock would not sit at its post-earnings low ahead of a quarter whose revenue is effectively known.
findings.independence: Panabee (https://www.panabee.com/news/integra-resources-earnings-q3-2026, 2026-10-22) independently computes that the ~25.8koz Q4 midpoint needs +46% q/q. The company release (https://www.ariva.de/news/integra-announces-third-quarter-gold-production-of-17-652-12178957, 2026-10-22) is the primary source of the 52.5% recovery and the reaffirmation. All three rest on the same company numbers.

findings.finding: The reported quarter is effectively pre-released and lands on the bar. 16,760 oz sold at a Q3 LBMA average of ~$4,262/oz (WGC) gives ~$71.4m of gold revenue plus ~12.5koz of silver, against the $71.1m consensus (Q2 was $70.8m on 15,794 oz at a realised $4,426). Preliminary cash rose to $119.5m from $111.1m at June 30 with no financing disclosed, implying quarterly free cash flow similar to Q2's $9.3m. EPS should be near the $0.06 bar.

findings.why_not_priced: It is priced. Ounces sold and cash were released on Oct 22 and consensus revenue already equals sold ounces times the Q3 gold average. It is filed so the panel can see that the top line carries no surprise.
findings.independence: Q3 gold price average $4,262: https://en.apa.az/energy-and-industry/gold-prices-on-global-markets-exceed-4200-in-third-quarter-534026 (WGC figures). Q2 comparison: https://www-web.itiger.com/news/2658394697. Bar: https://www.earningswhispers.com/article/ITRG/22832.

findings.finding: Q3 AISC is not yet disclosed and leans to the top of the $3,300-3,500/oz guide. Q3 set a record for material moved (~9.0Mt, 97,428 tpd), and lower recovery means more tonnes per ounce produced. The realised price fell from $4,426 to ~$4,260, trimming the ~$7/oz royalty effect per $100 of gold. H1 mine-site AISC was $3,344 and Q2 $3,371. Industry cost inflation is reported at a 13-year high and Newmont raised its 2026 cost outlook in Q3. A Q3 AISC above $3,500, or a hint of an FY cost guide change, would compress a ~$800-900/oz margin.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: June 2026 cost guidance raise (AISC $2,750-2,950 to $3,300-3,500): the stock has fallen ~21% since the July mine-plan update (Earnings Whispers). Q2 AISC of $3,371 was inside the guide and the stock rose +3.85%.
findings.why_not_priced: Q3 AISC has not been published; the Oct 22 operating release carried no cost figures. If the market had priced an over-guide AISC, sell-side cuts like HC Wainwright's FY EPS cut ($0.28 to $0.23, July) would have continued into Q3 previews. Instead EPS consensus is flat at $0.06.
findings.independence: Proxy only: industry cost inflation at a 13-year high (https://miningmx.com/2026-11-03-gold-mining-cost-inflation-hits-13-year-high/, 2026-11-03); Newmont raised its 2026 cost outlook (https://www.kitco.com/news/article/2026-10-22/newmont-beats-third-quarter-earnings-expectations-higher-gold-sales-boost, 2026-10-22). Company-level transmission is not confirmed.

findings.finding: Gold has drifted below the guide's assumption since quarter end. Spot is ~$4,070-4,126 on 2026-11-09 and touched ~$3,923 in late October, against the $4,200 assumption in the FY cost guide and the Q3 average of ~$4,262. Q4 realised price and margin commentary on the call will be weaker than Q3.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-10-30 (no results; a code-of-conduct 6-K) -6.25% in a week gold fell toward $3,923, which suggests high gold beta. Not an earnings reaction.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the stock trades gold daily. Filed only because a call that frames Q4 margins at sub-$4,200 gold is an incremental negative on the guide line.

baseline_tension: There is no skew to agree or disagree with. The negative lean on guide survival runs with the -7% 20-day run-up and the depressed positioning, so it is partly priced, which is why p_up sits at 45 and not lower.
lessons_applied: Lesson 3 (own caveat reaches the number): the guidance finding shrank from -1.0 to -0.8, because the Oct 22 reaffirmation three weeks into Q4 and the 25% higher ore placement argue against a cut.
Lesson 5 (proxy is small): the AISC finding shrank from -0.5 to -0.4, because the cost evidence beyond the company's own Q2 trend is industry proxies (miningmx, Newmont).
Last lesson (rebuild the base rate when baseline_history_trustworthy is false): confirmed that only the 2026-08-11 row is a results print; abs_move rests on realised volatility, not the 3.12% median.
Lesson 6 (bar): EPS $0.06 is confirmed by two sources; the revenue bar is single-source, but the finding on it is sized at 0, so no cap was binding.
